p0_quiescence_evidence.source: committed autonomous Free Swarm/provider-budget dashboard refresh
p0_quiescence_evidence.interpretation: Direct shared-budget counters continued to advance after HARD_OFF. This is evidence of continued provider-attempt activity, not a scientific negative about EntityOS/model behavior and not authorization to probe the provider.

physical_witness_temporal_audit.finding: The retained spawn_held_cohort returns only after release plus communicate/wait/reap; therefore an external post-return pidfd mint cannot establish mint-at-barrier provenance reliably.
physical_witness_temporal_audit.required_repair: Acquire process handles and bind a complete pre-release NODE_RESULT or packet commitment while all ten children are still held at the common barrier, then require exact equality after release before mutation.

pidfd_getfd_research.mechanism: During the live barrier, use pidfd_getfd on the pidfd-referenced child target fd; locally fstat and F_GETFL the duplicated descriptor and compare device/inode/read-only access mode against the canonical S1 path stat performed inside the same observer-owned boundary.
pidfd_getfd_research.strength: This is stronger than trusting caller-supplied fdinfo rows because the minting boundary obtains a duplicate of the actual descriptor from the pidfd-referenced process incarnation.
remaining_limits: does not alone prove the intended SQLite read transaction is held
does not alone bind the final post-release NODE_RESULT/read-receipt to the pre-release cohort
does not alone prove observer source-byte consumption identity
pidfd_getfd permission/kernel support failure is infrastructure evidence and must fail closed without raw-mapping fallback

training_track.retained_design: B0-B6 Qwen3.5-0.8B BIND/ROUTE/REMAP curriculum from V69

hypothesis: A promotion-safe physical cohort witness requires two temporal phases: pre-release observation authority bound to process incarnation + actual S1 descriptor + packet commitment, followed by post-release equality verification. The model/training channel should never be able to reconstruct this authority from serialized semantic labels.
counterhypothesis: Post-release packets and caller-supplied proof fields are sufficient because they are generated by trusted code paths.
adjudication: Reject under fail-closed evidence law. Source convention is insufficient; the authority-bearing observation must be structurally bound before release and raw serialized reconstructions must be unable to reach PHYSICAL_OBSERVED mutation.
